state.objective: Determine why browser blocks POST requests from app.domain.com to api.domain.com.

submitted_answer.answer: The credentialed cross-origin POST is blocked because CORS combines a wildcard origin with allow_credentials=True. Configure an explicit trusted origin such as https://app.domain.com, return that exact value in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and keep Access-Control-Allow-Credentials set to true.
